input.folderLabel: Select a character folder (containing its .def file, e.g. kfm.def)
input.dropHint: …or drag and drop a character folder here
input.needsSelection: Found {{count}} .def files in the selected folder — pick which one is the character.
input.zssAmbiguousNote: Note: {{count}} .zss files were found in the folder — none was used, only a single .zss file is supported.
input.errorNoFilesDrop: Couldn't read anything from the dropped folder — your browser may not support folder drag-and-drop here. Try the folder picker button instead.
input.errorNoFilesPicker: This folder is empty — pick a folder that contains the character's .def file.
input.errorNoCandidate: No .def file found in this folder — expected one like kfm.def.
input.errorReferenceMissingKey: The selected .def doesn't reference a {{extension}} file at all.
input.errorReferenceNotFound: The selected .def references "{{referencedName}}" for its {{extension}} file, but that file wasn't found anywhere in the selected folder.
input.errorReferenceAmbiguous: The selected .def references "{{referencedName}}" for its {{extension}} file, but {{count}} files in the folder share that name — could not tell which one to use.
input.errorGather: The files could not be read from the selection.
input.causeParse: The editor couldn't understand these character files.

commands.heading: Commands
commands.inputHint: Written exactly as typed, for example "~D, DF, F, a". The editor does not check it against the MUGEN/Ikemen input syntax.
commands.nameDuplicate: Another command already uses this name.
commands.targetStateNotWholeNumber: Target state must be a whole number.
commands.timeHelp: Number of ticks within which the whole sequence must be entered. 1 tick = 1/60 s.
commands.bufferTimeHelp: Number of ticks a command stays active once entered, so that a slightly early press still counts. 1 tick = 1/60 s.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Name, author and the files that make up the character.

sprites.title: Sprites
sprites.description: Browse, import, replace and delete the character's images.

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Listen to the sounds the character can play.

palettes.title: Palettes
palettes.description: Recolour the character and save a palette file.

states.title: States
states.description: Describe what the character does in each state: standing, jumping, attacking.
states.help: A state describes what the character does at a given moment. Its controllers run every frame while the character is in that state. In the files, a state is written as a StateDef.

commands.title: Commands
commands.description: Define the button sequences that trigger moves.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Edit frames and their collision boxes.
animations.help: A hit box is where an attack touches; a hurt box is where the character can be hit. In the files they are called Clsn1 and Clsn2.

output.title: Export
output.description: Review the problems found, then export the character files.

home.hint: Drop a character folder, or start from scratch.
